input: only the sealed S01-2 feature cache produced under feature-extraction-contract-v01.json
unit: the four features from one A/C/E/P quartet; convert serialized float32 vectors to float64 for all arithmetic
fixed_metrics: L2 norm distributions for each delta factor and view
within-quartet cosine distributions for context/entity, context/paraphrase, and entity/paraphrase deltas
within-factor consistency: all unordered pairwise cosines among delta vectors in each declared comparison cell
matched context binding: within each context substitution pair, compare context displacement vectors over the 16 crossed entity aliases
matched entity binding: within each entity substitution pair, compare entity displacement vectors over the 16 crossed context aliases
template invariance: compare matched factor deltas for the same term IDs, relation, state, family, and counterpart term across the balanced observation/query template schedule

primary_factorial_cell.on_shortage: FAIL_CLOSED; do not merge cells or lower the requirement

binding_cell.on_shortage: FAIL_CLOSED; each changed-term pair must be crossed with all 16 fixed-factor aliases within the declared split

descriptive_statistics: nearest-rank p10, p25, median, p75, and p90, plus n, minimum, and maximum; report every declared subgroup and its support
cosine: dot(a,b)/(max(||a||,1e-12)*max(||b||,1e-12)); zero vectors yield 0 cosine and are counted
distance: Euclidean L2 over float64-converted raw feature values; no centering, scaling, normalization, learned metric, or dimensionality reduction
pairwise_rule: all unordered pairs i<j in each supported cell; no sampled pairs
analysis_limit: descriptive cartography only; no probe fitting, hypothesis selection, significance search, representation ranking, or rescue gate
